performance.driver: Sales volume increased 2%, as growth in Asia Pacific and Latin America offset losses in EMEA driven by challenging market conditions.
Revenue increased 13% sequentially and 23% from the same quarter a year ago with broad growth led by industrial, data center and automotive.

Our consolidated revenue for the three months ended June 30, 2026 was $13.6 billion, an increase of $4.5 billion, or 50%, compared to the three months ended June 30, 2025, attributable to increased revenue of $3.2 billion, $0.9 billion, and $0.4 billion in our aviation, marine, and land segments, respectively, as discussed further below.
